question: Does reading an unnecessary source version impair snapshot answers more than reading an unrelated fact after controlling extra-token budget, values and position?
distractor_updates: 8/64 balanced over base facts; descriptive strata, not a causal duration comparison
program: Initialize distinct target, source, intermediate and unrelated accounts; add background updates.
Execute the original-source-to-target snapshot COPY chain.
Append SET source = n and SET unrelated = n, using the same new integer n for both records.
Evaluate both orders of the two late SETs; the target's copied truth is unchanged.

readout_masks.oracle: Only the executable backward slice, plus prelude and causal query/answer tokens.
readout_masks.extra_source: Oracle plus the late source SET.
readout_masks.extra_unrelated: Oracle plus the late unrelated SET.

controls: No optimization, failure selection or checkpoint selection on the new cohort.
Build and validate executable gold and all balanced conditions before model evaluation; freeze cases and token masks by hash.
Within each query, all masks use the identical complete original input and prefix computation.
Source/unrelated extras have identical assigned value and exact retained token count; swap their original late positions across paired variants.
All-history identity and restricted-prefix/cache checks for every checkpoint.
Report every depth, wording, late order, checkpoint and paired base-fact score. Bootstrap by base fact; do not count conditions, orders or seeds as independent facts.
limits: Oracle identities remain diagnostics, not learned routing.
Late source/unrelated SETs are independent operations; do not treat this test alone as evidence of correct handling of dependent order changes.
Existing source-before-COPY controls test necessary order sensitivity; fresh positive-order controls must also precede any architecture claim.
Do not expand shared recurrent/attention controllers until readout-only and ordinary adaptation controls leave a demonstrated functional gap.
notes: Raw unrestricted readout is evaluated as an additional competence baseline.
Case metadata, dependency indices and gold values are never appended to the model input.
